template.constraints: Ask the question naturally as an employee would. The bot should answer using its knowledge base. Accept any correct/helpful answer.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: Leave policy query
variants.goal: Ask about leave policy and get a relevant answer from the HR bot

phases.description: Ask 'tell me about leave policy'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers with leave policy information (credited in April, 14 days continuous leave, etc.) or cites leave policy document

variants.name: Company car policy query
variants.goal: Ask about company car policy and get knowledge-base answer

phases.description: Ask 'i want to know about car policy'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot explains company car policy (fuel reimbursement, tenure, maintenance, etc.) with policy source

variants.name: Hospitalization coverage days
variants.goal: Ask how many days before and after hospitalization are covered

phases.description: Ask 'How many days before and after hospitalization are covered?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers with specific day counts for pre/post hospitalization coverage

variants.name: DEI eligible population
variants.goal: Find out who is eligible under the DEI policy

phases.description: Ask 'Eligible population for DEI'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot explains which employee groups are eligible for the DEI program

variants.name: Variable pay after October joining
variants.goal: Ask if an employee who joined after October gets variable pay

phases.description: Ask 'Will I get variable pay if I joined after October?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers whether joining after October affects variable pay eligibility

variants.name: Maternity benefit maximum
variants.goal: Find the maximum maternity benefit amount

phases.description: Ask 'What is the maximum maternity benefit I can get?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides the maximum maternity benefit amount or coverage details

variants.name: Cataract surgery limit
variants.goal: Ask about cataract surgery coverage limit

phases.description: Ask 'what is my cataract surgery limit'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides the cataract surgery coverage limit

variants.name: Maternity coverage increase query
variants.goal: Ask if maternity coverage can be increased

phases.description: Ask 'can i increase my maternity coverage'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot explains whether coverage can be increased or not

variants.name: HIV insurance coverage
variants.goal: Ask if HIV is covered under the insurance policy

phases.description: Ask 'Is HIV Covered in the insurance'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides a clear answer about HIV coverage in the insurance policy

variants.name: IVF fertility treatment coverage
variants.goal: Ask if IVF or infertility treatments are covered by the policy

phases.description: Ask 'Does this policy cover IVF or infertility treatments?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers clearly about IVF/infertility coverage

variants.name: Mental health treatment covered
variants.goal: Ask if mental health or psychiatric treatment is included in the policy

phases.description: Ask 'Is mental health or psychiatric treatment included?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers about mental health treatment coverage

variants.name: Ambulance coverage amount
variants.goal: Ask about the ambulance coverage amount in the mediclaim policy

phases.description: Ask 'What is the ambulance coverage amount?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides the ambulance coverage amount

variants.name: Add spouse or child after joining
variants.goal: Ask if spouse or child can be added to insurance after joining

phases.description: Ask 'Can I add my spouse or child after joining the company?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers whether family can be added and the process

variants.name: POSH policy applicability
variants.goal: Ask if the POSH policy applies only to women employees

phases.description: Ask 'Is this Posh policy only applicable to women employees'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot clarifies POSH policy applicability (it applies to all employees)

variants.name: Business travel advance planning days
variants.goal: Ask how many days in advance business travel should be planned

phases.description: Ask 'How many days in advance should I plan my business travel?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers with the advance planning requirement for business travel

variants.name: Business class flight for work
variants.goal: Ask if business class flights are allowed for work travel

phases.description: Ask 'Can I book business class flight for work travel?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot explains the policy on flight class for business travel

variants.name: Appraisal timelines this year
variants.goal: Ask about appraisal timelines for the current year

phases.description: Ask 'What are the timelines for appraisal this year?' or 'tell me appraisal timelines'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides appraisal timeline information or TAT
phases.recoveryHint: Try 'i want to know the timeline for appraisal' or 'mid year appraisal TAT'

variants.name: Promotions and rating decisions
variants.goal: Ask how promotions are decided in the company

phases.description: Ask 'How are promotions decided in the company?' and 'Who decides my final performance rating?'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers about the promotion and rating process

variants.name: Policy - leave policy Hinglish
variants.goal: Ask about leave policy in Hinglish and get a relevant answer

phases.description: Ask 'i want leave policy' — in lowercase/casual format
phases.completionCriteria: Bot answers with leave policy information

variants.name: Policy - payslip request
variants.goal: Ask for a payslip — which may be out of scope — and see how bot handles it

phases.description: Ask 'i need my payslip'
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either provides payslip info or politely explains it cannot help with this and redirects to HR services
